## Simulations

```{julia}
using CairoMakie, Distributions, Random
```

Lets begin with a toy example problem of a multivariate normal distribution of
$X$ and $Y$, where:

$$
[X Y] \sim \text{ Multivariate Nomral } \Left [\mu_X \mu_Y], \Sigma \Right)
$$
